messages.content: You extract structured facts from a customer's refrigerator complaint. Reply with one JSON object and nothing else.

Attributes and their allowed values:
- cooling_type (Direct-cool (manual defrost, no fans; common single-door models in India) or frost-free (fan-forced, auto defrost)): direct_cool | frost_free
- primary_symptom (Main complaint (ice_buildup = solid ice at the bottom of a compartment; frost_buildup = frost or ice coating the walls / back panel)): not_cooling | over_cooling | noise | leaking_water | ice_buildup | frost_buildup | not_powering_on | runs_constantly
- compartment_affected (Which compartment shows the symptom): fridge | freezer | both
- compressor_running (Compressor at the lower back is humming / warm / vibrating): yes | no
- noise_type (Unusual sound from the unit (users usually attribute any sound to the compressor)): none | normal_hum | loud_hum_or_buzz | clicking | knocking_or_rattling | squealing_or_chirping
- noise_location (Where an unusual sound comes from (iFixit noise pages use it to tell fans from compressor)): inside_compartment | back_bottom | not_applicable
- condenser_fan_running (Fan near the compressor at the lower back is spinning while the compressor runs): yes | no | not_applicable
- evaporator_fan_running (Fan behind the freezer back panel is running (heard/felt with door switch pressed)): yes | no | not_applicable
- condenser_coils_dusty (Condenser coils (back or underneath) visibly covered in dust or lint): yes | no
- door_seal_condition (Door gasket intact and sealing (e.g. paper-slip test)): good | damaged_or_gap
- vents_blocked_or_overloaded (Compartment packed full or internal air vents blocked by food): yes | no
- placement_clearance (Space around the unit and distance from heat sources): adequate | too_close_or_hot
- recent_relocation (Unit moved or newly installed in the last few days): yes | no
- power_supply_ok (Interior light / display comes on (the unit is getting power)): yes | no
- works_in_other_socket (Unit powers on when plugged into a different socket (iFixit's extension-cord test)): yes | no
- thermostat_setting (Temperature control position relative to normal): too_warm | normal | too_cold
- frost_on_back_wall (Frost or ice layer on the inside back wall of the freezer/fridge): yes | no
- water_leak_location (Where water appears, if anywhere): none | inside_compartment | under_unit
- error_code (Error code on the display): none | displayed | no_display

Rules:
- Include only attributes the message states or clearly implies; leave out everything else.
- Use exactly one listed value per attribute, spelled as listed.
- Negations matter ("compressor not running" -> compressor_running: no).
- The message may mix English with Romanized Kannada or Hindi and contain typos.

Example message: """my freezer is not freezing and there is a clicking sound from the back"""
Example output: {"attributes": {"primary_symptom": "not_cooling", "compartment_affected": "freezer", "noise_type": "clicking", "noise_location": "back_bottom"}}

Customer message: """fridge bilkul band pada hai, na light hai na display"""
Machine gloss of Kannada/Hindi words and typos: """fridge completely off lying is, na light is na display"""
Output: {"attributes": {...}}
